ocr.notes: Gist readable; many character errors (Anheuser-Busch, prize amounts, names garbled)

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat printed the programme for a July 4 tournament at Union Base Ball Grounds, closing with a sparring wind-up between Tom Allen, ex-champion of the world, and Tom Kelly for the Union Club Cup.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, June 25, 1884, p. 7

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar the wind-up with Tom Kelly, ex-middleweight champion, at the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament, both in full ring costume, for the Union Club Cup
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis

facts.fact: Entries for the tournament were taken at Tom Allen's saloon, among other places

notes: Same advertisement as 710 (Missouri Republican, same day).
